name: Kind Thoughts for a Busy Day
description: Ten short, friendly thoughts to read between tasks.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short deck of friendly thoughts for a busy day, shown on Calm Cards.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. One card is plenty.
howToPlay: Read the thought on the card.
Press Show more for a little extra, if there is any.
tips: These are just kind words, not advice. Skip any that do not suit your day.
